title: Logitech MX Keys Mini Wireless Keyboard, Graphite — Compact Backlit Keys for Mac & Windows
bullets: Connect via Bluetooth 5.1 to three devices or use the included USB-C cable for near-zero latency gaming.
Hot-swappable sockets let you change Gateron switches without soldering — browns pre-installed for tactile typing.
Compact 75% layout keeps arrow keys and function row while freeing desk space versus full-size boards.
description: The Keychron K2 is a 75% wireless mechanical keyboard popular with developers who want Mac-friendly layouts without giving up Windows shortcuts.

reviews.author: Devan S.
reviews.title: Perfect Mac + Windows desk setup
reviews.body: Side OS switch is genius. Browns feel great for long coding sessions and Bluetooth to the MBP is rock solid.

reviews.author: Rita A.
reviews.title: Good value, stock stabs rattle
reviews.body: After clipping and lubing stabs it is quiet enough for open office. Out of the box they were a bit pingy.
